newsitem.title: THAILAND: Export value of Jan-Apr Thai vehicles, parts up.
newsitem.headline: Export value of Jan-Apr Thai vehicles, parts up.

text.p: The export value of Thai assembled vehicles and parts rose sharply in the first four months to 6.48 billion baht ($250 million) from 2.93 billion baht in the same period last year, an industry group said.

The export value of cars and car parts during the January-April period surged to 4.14 billion baht from 735 million in the same period a year ago, the Thai Automotive Industry Association said in a statement.
The value of motorcycles and motorcycle part exports in the period was up to 2.35 billion baht from 2.19 billion in the same period in a previous year, it said.
The total number of passenger cars and commercial vehicles assembled in Thailand in the first four months was down four percent to 174,124 from 181,482 in the same period last year, it said.
